name: Kerala State Data Centre-1 (SDC-1), Co-Bank Towers
notes: Kerala State IT Mission states Kerala has two State Data Centers monitored and managed by KSITM; KSITM tender records place State Data Centre-1 at Co-Bank Towers, Palayam/PMG Junction, Thiruvananthapuram. No public MW figure found.

name: Kerala State Data Centre-2 (SDC-2), Thejaswini Building, Technopark
notes: Kerala State IT Mission states Kerala has two State Data Centers; KSITM tender and Kerala Police e-tender references identify State Data Centre-2 at Thejaswini Building/Technopark Campus, Kazhakuttam, Thiruvananthapuram. No public MW figure found.

name: STPI Thiruvananthapuram Data Center
notes: STPI's Thiruvananthapuram directorate has a Data Center service page, and STPI identifies the Thiruvananthapuram centre as located in Technopark. Public page describes STPI data-centre services but does not publish local MW capacity.

Targeted searches for Thrissur data center/datacenter/server farm/colocation/hyperscale and operator names found IT-service companies, Infopark Thrissur business listings, and remote data-center-support services, but no verified physical data center project or operating facility in Thrissur District.

name: Wayanad AI and Data Center Park
developer: Malayalee Festival Federation (proposed PPP/collaboration with government and investors)
notes: The UNN/Global Net News report says the Malayalee Festival Federation planned to formally announce a Wayanad AI and Data Center Park in South Wayanad between Kalpetta and Nilambur, with AI R&D, innovation labs, skilling centers, and a modern data center. This appears early-stage with no published MW capacity, permits, land allocation, or construction evidence found.

Targeted searches for Kargil/Ladakh data center, datacenter, server farm, cloud, colocation, hyperscale, NIC, state data centre, and named operators found general district NIC presence and political references, but no verified physical data center project or facility in Kargil. The verified Ladakh State Data Centre is in Leh, not Kargil.

name: Ladakh State Data Centre, Upper Tukcha, Leh
developer: Information Technology Department, Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh / NIC support
notes: UT Ladakh official release documented January 2024 review of ongoing work on the Ladakh State Data Centre at the Civil Secretariat in Leh; local press reports the state-of-the-art facility was inaugurated at Upper Tukcha, Leh on October 4, 2024. No public MW capacity found.

name: Lakshadweep State Data Centre (L-SDC)
developer: Lakshadweep Information Technology Services Society / UT Administration of Lakshadweep
notes: Official LITSS page identifies Lakshadweep State Data Centre as a core e-governance infrastructure element under NeGP and says State Data Centres are proposed to consolidate services, applications, and infrastructure. Public page does not confirm commissioning date or MW capacity.
